name: auto-handoff
description: When the context reaches a limit (300k tokens by default), asks Claude to pause when it can, then runs /handoff, /clear and /pickup by itself. Never interrupts a running turn.

thresholdTokens.title: Context limit (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: The context size at which the handoff starts. Default 300000.

handoffsDir.title: Handoffs folder
handoffsDir.description: The folder /handoff writes to. Leave empty to use the handoffs folder inside your Claude config folder.
